why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2 and 4 hold. Check 1's cases (bounds, lo===hi, negatives) and check 2's RangeError cases follow from what their lines say. Check 4 only needs exit code 0 and no failing tests. Check 3 breaks the criterion. The expect line asks only that README.md "documents every function math.js exports". The check's script fails unless there is a markdown heading matching `^#+\s*name\s*\(`, and its FAIL condition says "any exported function has no heading or no description". A README could document a function in a list, a table or a paragraph without a heading. Requiring a heading is a format rule the words don't force, so it belonged under Advisory, not in the PASS/FAIL condition.
